R1.description: A stream with a rejected rate_limit_event, a 429 is_error result and a finite resetsAt has a usage_limit fact in its diagnosis (reason usage_limit, outcome still FAILURE); a stream with any of the three missing, or only the localised text, has none and classifies as before; timeout and signal reasons keep precedence

R2.description: A limited job that moved nothing (protocol: reconcile answers no_progress and HEAD and the tracked-change list are unchanged; legacy: phase, HEAD and the tracked-change list unchanged) is recorded INTERRUPTED with usage_limit and UsageLimitReached, not FAILED, in execute_step and in resume (the tracked-change comparison includes worktree digests, worktree executable bits and staged blob identities, so index-only and mode-only progress is FAILED); every other limited job, including one whose transition verified, stays FAILED and carries usage_limit in its evidence

R3.description: The usage accounting charges such a job as a job that ran (measured or at the forecast), never as one that never launched, and no job-status enumeration changes and the only schema additions are the optional usage_limit block and the tracked_changes pre-state member

R4.description: run waits for the reset plus usage.resume_grace_seconds (bounded by usage.max_wait_seconds, with or without usage.enabled), holding no lock, records usage_paused, repeats the step through the whole boundary and counts no step for the attempt; three limited attempts in a row stop with 17, each stop with its own line

R5.description: step exits 17 with a line naming the reset time and the repeat; an INTERRUPTED job without the fact exits 40; resume keeps exit 40 and names the reset; a wait over the bound exits 17 without sleeping; Ctrl-C during the wait is a one-line interruption whose mid-job message does not say "nothing was started"

R6.description: The first job after a window reset, admitted after it (today after_reset), has a measured delta and yields a forecast sample, while a job admitted before the reset keeps after_reset and its conservative charge, or the follow-up is deferred with the finding recorded and no schema change made

R7.description: The exit-code, problems, run and guide pages, and the roadmap, agree with the behaviour; check_docs, the golden --check forms and the full suite are green
